statement: Let n = len(nums). Let C be the number of ordered pairs (i,j) of integers such that 0 <= i, i+2 <= j < n, and for every k with i <= k < j-1, nums[k+1]-nums[k] = nums[k+2]-nums[k+1]. Whenever the function returns a result r, r = C.
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 5000, and for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), -1000 <= nums[i] <= 1000.

statement: For every input nums satisfying the preconditions, the function returns a result (it does not fail, panic, or overflow).
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 5000, and for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), -1000 <= nums[i] <= 1000.

statement: Let n = len(nums). Whenever the function returns a result r, 0 <= r <= (n-1)*(n-2)/2.
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 5000, and for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), -1000 <= nums[i] <= 1000.

statement: Let n = len(nums). Whenever the function returns a result r, r > 0 if and only if there exists an integer i such that 0 <= i < n-2 and nums[i+1]-nums[i] = nums[i+2]-nums[i+1].
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 5000, and for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), -1000 <= nums[i] <= 1000.

statement: Let n = len(nums), and for 0 <= k < n-1 let d[k] = nums[k+1]-nums[k]. Partition the index set {0,1,...,n-2} (empty when n=1) into its unique maximal contiguous blocks B such that all d[k] for k in B are equal and adjacent blocks have different d-values. For a block B let t = |B|. Whenever the function returns a result r, r = sum over all such blocks B of t*(t-1)/2.
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 5000, and for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), -1000 <= nums[i] <= 1000.

statement: For every slice b satisfying 1 <= len(b) <= 5000 and -1000 <= b[i] <= 1000 for all i, if len(b)=len(nums) and b[i]=nums[len(nums)-1-i] for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), then whenever the function returns q on nums and q_b on b, q = q_b.
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 5000, and for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), -1000 <= nums[i] <= 1000.

statement: For every integer c and every slice b satisfying 1 <= len(b) <= 5000 and -1000 <= b[i] <= 1000 for all i, if len(b)=len(nums) and b[i]=nums[i]+c for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums) (integer addition), then whenever the function returns q on nums and q_b on b, q = q_b.
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 5000, and for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), -1000 <= nums[i] <= 1000.

statement: For every integer c with c != 0 and every slice b satisfying 1 <= len(b) <= 5000 and -1000 <= b[i] <= 1000 for all i, if len(b)=len(nums) and b[i]=c*nums[i] for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums) (integer multiplication), then whenever the function returns q on nums and q_b on b, q = q_b.
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 5000, and for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), -1000 <= nums[i] <= 1000.

statement: For every slice b satisfying 1 <= len(b) <= 5000 and -1000 <= b[i] <= 1000 for all i, if len(b) <= len(nums) and b[i]=nums[i] for every i with 0 <= i < len(b), then whenever the function returns q on nums and q_b on b, q >= q_b.
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 5000, and for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), -1000 <= nums[i] <= 1000.

statement: For every such pair (i,j) with 0 <= i, i+2 <= j < len(nums) and all consecutive differences on nums[i..j] equal, whenever the function returns a result r, r >= (j-i)*(j-i-1)/2.
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 5000, for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), -1000 <= nums[i] <= 1000, and there exist integers i,j with 0 <= i, i+2 <= j < len(nums) such that nums[i..j] is arithmetic.
